summary.intent: Continue executing phase 70 of the CipherBox GSD plan, progressing wave 5 (plan 70-07 terminal-owner zeroization) and starting wave 6, the final plan 70-08 (sdk-e2e crash-safety gate).
summary.outcome: Wave 5 completed with 70-07 verified (paired zeroization test, typed RootKeyStaleError fallback, Open-Q2 accepted as residual; sdk 29/29 + 342 full-suite pass, tsc clean). Wave 6 (70-08) started: determined the live docker stack was down, located the stack bring-up recipe, and split the work — dispatched an agent to author+typecheck the e2e test cases while the live gate run (stack bring-up + suite execution) is retained for the assistant.

repo: cipherbox sdk-e2e suite requires a live stack: API on :3000, redis on :6380, kubo on :5001 — plain `vitest run`, no built-in stack bring-up.
No compose file exists at the usual paths for sdk-e2e; stack setup is documented only in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md, which also defines the SDK_E2E_SECRET default env var.
Containers named irl-network-* on :5433/:6379 belong to a different, unrelated project — not the cipherbox stack (which needs :3000/:6380/:5001).
workflow: For phase-gate plans requiring live infra (e.g. sdk-e2e), check whether the stack is actually up before dispatching the executor — bring-up is a prerequisite, not something to discover mid-run.

Split live-infra-dependent plans: dispatch an agent to author/typecheck tests against existing patterns while retaining the live gate run (stack bring-up + suite execution) for direct execution, since full stack bring-up is finicky in this environment.

friction: docker stack for cipherbox was not running when wave 6 began, blocking the 70-08 e2e gate.
No compose file at the expected paths for sdk-e2e; had to dig through the README and then docs/DEVELOPMENT.md to find the actual stack bring-up recipe.
open_items: Bring up the live cipherbox stack (API :3000, redis :6380, kubo :5001) and run the sdk-e2e crash-safety gate for plan 70-08 (final plan, 8/8) once the agent finishes authoring the two test cases.
Open-Q2 from 70-07 was traced and accepted as a residual (not resolved) — worth revisiting if it resurfaces.
